Scope: Independent source review and rehash of completed owner simulation evidence; no simulation rerun

SourceReview.HeldAW: awvalid depends on ADDRESS and rst_n, never failed; base and written_beats cannot change during an AW stall
SourceReview.HeldW: writing is not gated by failed; complete packed burst remains immutable through AW and all requested W beats
SourceReview.TagFault: admission stops and sticky failed is set; ADDRESS/WRITE finish exactly one outstanding burst then FAULT; last-W coincidence cannot publish done
SourceReview.StripeOwnership: collection requires not-full, reads require full; last synchronous return is packed before free/toggle; issue limited to 256 per burst
SourceReview.PartialStripe: issued and slot persist across stripe boundaries; no assumption that WIDTH*8 is divisible by 256
SourceReview.CRC: only pack_pixel advances little-endian RGB565 CRC in raster order; stalls do not advance it
SourceReview.Completion: frame has fixed N accepted pixels, N/16 W beats, 32-cycle final drain and no fault; no result publication before writer done
